short_bio: Singer-songwriter and the first artist to win the Grammy for Album of the Year four times.
biography:
Taylor Swift was born in West Reading, Pennsylvania, moved to Nashville as a teenager and released her self-titled debut album in 2006. Fearless (2008) won the Grammy for Album of the Year at the 2010 ceremony.

1989 (2014), Folklore (2020) and Midnights (2022) won the same award later, making her the first artist with four. In 2021 she began re-recording her early albums as “Taylor’s Version” after a dispute over ownership of her original master recordings.

The Eras Tour ran from 2023 to 2024 and Time named her Person of the Year in 2023.
